# mvdmio

> mvdmio builds five software products: Compliance, Translation Tools, Health Check, Statistics and Commonplace. Compliance leads and is a management system for running ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR and other frameworks. mvdmio is built and run by Michiel van der Meer.

## Products

- [Compliance](https://mvdm.io/products/compliance/): a management system billed per framework (ISO 27001, SOC 2, ISO 9001, ISO 42001, BIO2, GDPR and others) from one set of records, with AI credit included.
- [Compliance for ISO 27001](https://mvdm.io/products/compliance/iso-27001/): running an ISO 27001 information security management system in Compliance, with registers, a 5×5 risk matrix, Annex A controls, audits and findings.
- [Compliance for ISO 42001](https://mvdm.io/products/compliance/iso-42001/): running an ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system in Compliance, with clauses 4 to 10, Annex A controls, a Statement of Applicability, a 5×5 risk matrix and crosswalks to ISO 27001.
- [Compliance for the EU AI Act](https://mvdm.io/products/compliance/eu-ai-act/): tracking EU AI Act requirements in Compliance, with an Applicability page for marking which apply, shared registers and crosswalk topics that show where the EU AI Act and ISO 42001 overlap.
- [Compliance for SOC 2](https://mvdm.io/products/compliance/soc-2/): preparing for a SOC 2 examination in Compliance, with the Trust Services Criteria for every category, shared registers, a 5×5 risk matrix and crosswalks to ISO 27001 and GDPR.
- [Compliance for gemeenten (in Dutch)](https://mvdm.io/nl/gemeenten/): a Dutch page for Dutch municipalities that track BIO2 and the GDPR together in Compliance.
- [Translation Tools](https://mvdm.io/products/translation-tools/): keeps `.resx` files as the source of truth, fills empty locales with AI, and ships a NuGet client and a `translations` CLI for .NET projects.
- [Health Check](https://mvdm.io/products/health-check/): monitors uptime, DNS and SSL certificates, and crawls your app with automated smoke tests.
- [Statistics](https://mvdm.io/products/statistics/): tracks active users, throughput and response times across your applications from raw request data, self-hosted, with a drop-in .NET client.
- [Commonplace](https://mvdm.io/products/commonplace/): a personal place for books, quotes, notes, contacts and reminders, on an annual licence.

## Company

- [About](https://mvdm.io/about/): Michiel van der Meer, the software engineer and architect who builds and runs mvdmio, with two decades in industrial automation.
- [Open source](https://mvdm.io/open-source/): the MIT-licensed .NET packages mvdmio maintains on GitHub.
- [Legal](https://mvdm.io/legal/): Terms of Service, Privacy Notice, Data Processing Agreement, Subprocessor list, Company details and Partner terms, each as a PDF and all six as one pack.
